dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.denied: You do not have permission to open that page.

venues.title: Venues & seating plans
venues.description: Locations and their reusable master seating plans.
venues.newDescription: Create a location. Master seating plans are added after saving.

form.name: Name
form.coordinatesHint: Used for wallet passes and maps.
form.mapsUrlHint: Used in the shop for “Show on map”. Empty = a link is generated from the address or coordinates.

plans.title: Master seating plans
plans.description: Reusable layouts. Each event gets its own editable copy when it is created.
plans.name: Name
plans.deleteDescription: “{name}” will be deleted permanently. Events that were created from it keep their own copies.

danger.title: Delete venue
danger.description: Removes the venue and its {plans, plural, =0 {master plans} one {master plan} other {# master plans}} permanently.
danger.hasEvents: This venue still has {count, plural, one {# event} other {# events}} (including archived ones). Once no events exist any more, the venue can be deleted.
danger.confirmDescription: The venue and its {plans, plural, =0 {master plans} one {master plan} other {# master plans}} are removed. This cannot be undone.

events.title: Events
events.description: Performances, sales windows, pricing and access.

create.description: The selected master plan is copied for this event and can be adjusted afterwards.
create.noTaxRates: No active tax rate exists. Add one in the settings first.

fields.title: Title
fields.subtitle: Subtitle
fields.slugHint: Part of the shop URL. Lowercase letters, digits and hyphens.
fields.templateHint: Copied into an event plan you can edit independently.
fields.timesHint: Times are entered in the event's time zone.
fields.orphanSeatRuleHint: When enabled, customers cannot continue to the cart if their selection would leave a single empty seat in a row. The rule is checked when they click “Continue to cart”.

publish.title: Status & publishing
publish.description: Only published events are visible in the shop.

checklist.category: At least one active price category
checklist.tariff: At least one online tariff offered in a category
checklist.inventory: Seats or standing areas with a price category

sales.title: Sales settings
sales.windowsHint: Times in {timeZone}. Without a public sale start the event is on sale as soon as it is published.
sales.salesPausedHint: Emergency stop: nobody can enter the shop or check out.
sales.limitsHint: Leave empty to use the global setting.
sales.companionRequiresWheelchair: Companion seats only with wheelchair space

danger.title: Delete event permanently
danger.description: Removes the event with its seating plan, prices, tariffs, access codes and waiting-room data. This cannot be undone.
danger.notArchived: Available only for archived events. Archive the event first.
danger.hasOrders: This event has orders. Orders and invoices are accounting records that must be retained, so the event cannot be deleted – keep it archived instead.
danger.confirmDescription: Type the exact event title to confirm.

page.title: Shop page
page.description: Arrange the event page and add info boxes – e.g. accepted proofs of reduction or notes for people with disabilities.
page.layoutHint: Drag a block onto the left or right half of another block to place it next to it (up to {max} per row), or onto a gap between rows to give it a row of its own. The seating plan always uses the full width. The header with title, date and venue stays at the top.
page.boxesHint: Notes with title, icon and text – place them in the page layout above, e.g. next to the description. Up to {max} boxes; empty boxes are removed when saving.

discounts.title: Accepted proofs of reduction
discounts.content:
Please show a valid proof at the entrance, for example:

  • Pupil or student ID

  • Disability card

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.content: Wheelchair spaces and companion seats are marked on the seating plan. Please contact us if you need any assistance.

page.dropNewRow: Drop here for a row of its own
page.mobileHint: On mobile phones the blocks of a row are shown one below the other.

categories.title: Price categories
categories.description: Assign categories to seats and standing areas in the seating editor.
categories.name: Name
categories.deleteDescription: “{name}” is removed from all seats of this event.

types.title: Tariffs
types.description: Customers pick seats first and choose a tariff per seat in the cart. Reductions are verified at the entrance.
types.name: Name
types.channelsRequired: Select at least one sales channel.
types.requiresProofHint: The scanner shows a yellow warning so staff can check the proof (e.g. student ID).

matrix.title: Availability & prices
matrix.description: Which tariff is offered in which category, optionally with a category-specific price or discount (e.g. “Reduced” −5 € in Cat 1 but −4 € in Cat 2).
matrix.modesHint: “Tariff default” uses the tariff’s own discount rule. Fixed price, discount amount and discount % apply to this category only.

seating.title: Event seating plan
seating.description: This plan is a copy of the master plan and can be changed at any time without affecting other events.
seating.noPlan: This event has no seating plan.
seating.missingCategories: {seats} seats and {areas} standing areas have no price category and cannot be sold.

queue.globalDescription: Applies to every event that has no own waiting-room configuration.
queue.eventDescription: Controls how visitors enter the shop during high demand.
queue.useGlobalHint: Turn off to configure this event individually.

AUTO_THRESHOLD.label: Automatic
AUTO_THRESHOLD.description: Visitors queue only while the number of active shoppers is at the threshold.

SCHEDULED_PRE_REGISTRATION.label: Scheduled with lobby
SCHEDULED_PRE_REGISTRATION.description: A lobby opens before sale start; at T-0 everyone in the lobby gets a place (first come or lottery) and is admitted in batches.

VIP_CODE_ONLY.label: Access code only
VIP_CODE_ONLY.description: Only visitors with a valid access code can enter.

HYBRID.label: Queue with code priority
HYBRID.description: Everyone without a code waits in the queue; valid access codes skip it.

hints.activeSessionThreshold: Capacity of shoppers browsing the seating plan at the same time.
hints.passTokenTtlSeconds: How long an admitted visitor may shop before re-queueing.

stats.title: Live status
stats.description: Current state of the waiting room (refresh the page to update).

reset.title: Reset waiting room?
reset.description: Removes everyone from the queue and lobby and ends all shopping windows. Carts stay reserved until they expire.

announcements.title: Announcements
announcements.description: Shown live to everyone in the waiting room.

accessCodes.createDescription: VIP and presale codes. Single-use codes are bound to the first visitor who redeems them.
accessCodes.codeHint: Letters, digits and hyphens; stored in upper case.
accessCodes.label: Internal label

richText.linkHint: Allowed: https://, http://, mailto: and tel: links.

settings.title: Settings
settings.description: Shop-wide configuration. Changes take effect within a few seconds.

general.title: General
general.description: Shop name and defaults for new events.
general.shopNameHint: Shown in the browser title and the shop header.
general.defaultLocaleHint: Used for e-mails and formatting when no language is known.
general.defaultCurrencyHint: ISO code, e.g. EUR. Pre-filled when creating events.
general.defaultTimeZoneHint: IANA name, e.g. Europe/Berlin. Pre-filled for new venues and events.

branding.title: Branding
branding.description: Colours and legal links of the shop.
branding.logoLater: Logo and favicon upload will be available with the media library.

checkout.title: Seat selection & cart
checkout.description: Global defaults for reservations, limits and seat selection.
checkout.overrideNotice: These are global defaults. Each event can override the reservation time, limits and selection options on its “Sales” tab.
checkout.cartLockTtlHint: How long selected seats stay reserved in the cart.
checkout.paymentGraceHint: Added when the customer starts paying so seats never expire mid-payment.
checkout.maxTicketsPerCustomer: Max. tickets per customer and event
checkout.manualSeatSelectionEnabled: Customers pick seats on the plan
checkout.orphanSeatRuleHint: Pre-selected when creating events; each event decides individually.
checkout.requireTermsAcceptance: Require acceptance of the terms at checkout
checkout.requireTermsAcceptanceHint: Customers must tick a checkbox linking to the terms URL.
checkout.companionSeatsRequireWheelchair: Companion seats only together with their wheelchair space
checkout.companionSeatsRequireWheelchairHint: A companion seat can only be booked when its wheelchair space (adjacent or assigned in the seating editor) is in the same order. Checked on “Continue to cart”.

seatDisplay.title: Seating chart colours
seatDisplay.description: How seat states are shown to customers on the seating chart.
seatDisplay.markUnavailableWithCross: Mark sold and blocked seats with a cross

selectionStyles.FILL: Fill the seat with the colour

symbols.title: Symbol library
symbols.description: Seat shapes and element icons for the seating editor.
symbols.uploadDescription: SVG files are cleaned on upload: only shapes and colours are kept, scripts and external references are removed.
symbols.name: Name
symbols.fileHint: Max. 200 KB, needs a viewBox or width/height.
symbols.colorizeHint: Replaces all colours with the category or element colour. Turn off to keep the original colours.
symbols.usage: {count, plural, =0 {not used} one {used # time} other {used # times}}
symbols.deleteUsed: “{name}” is used {count, plural, one {# time} other {# times}}. Seats fall back to the default shape and icons are removed from elements.
